An independent analytic magnetized radial equilibrium benchmark is complete under codex/external_model/radial_equilibrium/. The solution is valid in a shell: v constant, rho~r^-2,p~r^-3,Br~r^-2,Bt0,Omega0,gamma1.5, with3p0r0/rho0=GM. For r0=.1AU,p=2npkT, T0=179122.224473K. A single-sign radial field has its mathematical monopole source inside the excluded inner region; this is not a physical full-Sun field.

The frozen HLLD source requires no initial-condition change. A separate default-off exact-ghost branch supplies known analytic continuation and passive diagnostics; original physics/source/header/reference hashes remain unchanged.24x4x24,48x8x48,96x16x96 single-CPU runs to.02 and.1day pass without fallback/rejection. Free-stream outputs match original exactly except wall_seconds, both with the new ghost flag off and on.

At.1day global point-profile pressure L1 fractions1.213e-2,3.857e-3,1.158e-3; density2.425e-4,5.009e-5,1.348e-5; Br3.452e-4,5.393e-5,1.151e-5. Polar-velocity L1 .004264,.001213,.000314km/s, but maximum norms are lower order. Initial residuals and radial integral-flux errors also decrease. Mass/energy ledgers close below1.3e-13 including gravity and GLM damping.

Important qualifier: exact conserved-average errors show~second-order convergence but are dominated by O(h²) point-sample initialization. Separate double-precision profile preservation, initial semi-discrete residual and physical-flux references are reported; no blanket second-order or forecast-convergence claim. Largest final case~14CPU seconds,~136MB arrays; no GPU job. Report, numerical JSON/CSVs, exact source patch and convergence figure are retained.

  "content": "import json
import sys
import time

import numpy as np

import da as D
import maps as M
import run_helio as R

LOG = R.RUNS / "production_log.txt"


def log(msg):
    line = f"{time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')} {msg}"
    print(line, flush=True)
    with open(LOG, "a") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")


def member_inputs(tag):
    cfg = json.loads((R.RUNS / f"{tag}_config.json").read_text())
    mp = M.ccmc_wsa() if cfg["src"] == "ccmc" else M.inhouse(cfg["src"])
    return cfg, mp


def forward(tag, res, slices=False, snaps=(), t_start="2025-11-01T00:00", suffix=""):
    cfg, mp = member_inputs(tag)
    z = np.load(R.RUNS / f"{tag}_corr.npz")
    name = f"prod_{tag}_{res}{suffix}"
    wd = R.build(name, D.apply(mp, z["cv"], z["cn"]), cfg["rule"], res=res, t_start=t_start, t_end="2025-12-09T00:00", cme=cfg["cme"], extra=cfg["extra"],
                 slice_dt=10800 if slices else 0, snaps=snaps)
    rc, el = R.run(wd, mem="6G")
    pr = R.probes(wd)
    sc = R.score(pr, "2025-11-12", "2025-12-08", bodies=("earth", "stereo_a", "solar_orbiter", "mars"))
    cs = R.comet_stats(pr)
    out = {"tag": tag, "res": res, "wall_s": el, "rc": rc, "score": sc, "comet": cs}
    (R.RUNS / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
    log(f"forward {name} wall {el:.0f}s " + " ".join(f"{b}:{v['v_rmse']:.0f}/{v['n_med_ratio']:.2f}" for b, v in sc.items()) + f" comet n={cs['n']['gti_mean']:.2f} v={cs['v']['gti_mean']:.0f} F={cs['flux']['gti_mean']:.3g}")
    return name


def refine(tag, res, n_iter=3):
    cfg, mp = member_inputs(tag)
    da = dict(cfg["da"])
    da.pop("init_corr", None)
    name = f"{tag}_{res}ref"
    wd, pr, cv, cn, hist = D.assimilate(name, mp, cfg["rule"], tuple(cfg["bodies"]), n_iter=n_iter, res=res, cme=cfg["cme"], log=log, extra=cfg["extra"],
                                        init_corr=str(R.RUNS / f"{tag}_corr.npz"), t_start="2025-11-01T00:00", **da)
    (R.RUNS / f"{name}_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(cfg, res=res), indent=1))
    return name


if __name__ == "__main__":
    mode = sys.argv[1]
    if mode == "forward":
        res = sys.argv[2]
        slices = sys.argv[3] == "1"
        for tag in sys.argv[4:]:
            if (R.RUNS / "STOP").exists():
                break
            forward(tag, res, slices)
    elif mode == "refine":
        refine(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 3)
"
}
